comment: Water utility crossing shown on Sheet 20 crossing existing wastewater and gas lines, but no crossing detail identifies AE underground facility proximity or demonstrates 12-inch clearance. Verify that water line crossings do not impact AE underground conduit; if AE underground is present at these crossing locations, clearance dimensions must be labeled.
applicableAreas: Water line crossings with existing utilities in ROW

comment: Underground electrical infrastructure shown on Sheet 21; water and wastewater utilities shown on Sheet 19. The plans do not clearly identify whether any non-AE utilities are proposed in joint trenches with AE underground conduit, or indicate if a written joint-trench agreement with Austin Energy is on file.

Sheet 20 profile shows water line (Wtr-Ln-A) crossing existing wastewater and gas lines, but the crossing method (trenchless vs. open-cut) is not identified on the plan or profile. Vertical separation distances are not labeled. Without crossing method designation and labeled clearance dimensions, the applicable separation standard cannot be verified.
applicableAreas: Water utility tap in ROW crossing existing wastewater and gas lines

comment: Sheet 20 profile shows water line crossing under Valley View Road (public roadway), but encasement specifications (material type, diameter, extent) are not provided on the crossing detail sheets. Confirm encasement piping specifications for utilities crossing under the roadway per UCM 2.9.1.D.
applicableAreas: Water utility tap crossing under Valley View Road

comment: Demolition plan (Sheet 8) Site Demolition Notes do not address required transmission line safety clearances detailed in Sheet 3 Electric Transmission Notes. Missing: (1) pre-construction safety meeting requirement with Austin Energy 48 hours before work commencement, (2) barricade requirement 10 feet from transmission structures, (3) warning signs under overhead transmission facilities, and (4) prohibition on materials or spoils storage within transmission easement.
applicableAreas: Demolition activities adjacent to transmission easement and transmission structures

comment: Construction plans do not demonstrate maintenance of a 25-foot-wide access corridor with minimum 16-foot vertical clearance along the transmission ROW. Transmission easement boundaries and access corridor requirements are not graphically delineated on the site plan or erosion control plan.

Sheet 5 shows a 'Staging and Storage Area' on the western side of the site, but no vertical clearance dimensions or annotations are provided. The plan does not demonstrate the 14-foot minimum vertical clearance from existing and proposed vegetation and all other objects above the staging area.
applicableAreas: SCM staging area on western side of site

comment: Sheet 3 Electric Transmission Notes prohibit staging, spoils, and dumpsters within 25 feet of transmission structures. However, the transmission easement boundaries are not delineated on Sheet 5 (Erosion Control Plan) or Sheet 9 (Site Plan), making it impossible to verify that the shown staging area does not overlap transmission easement or violate 25-foot clearance from transmission structures.
applicableAreas: Staging and storage areas relative to transmission easement

comment: No electrical clearance zones or envelopes are graphically delineated on any plan sheets. Transmission line safety buffers (including the 25-foot no-dig zone and transmission easement boundaries referenced in Sheet 3 General Notes) are not shown. Distribution overhead conductor clearance envelopes are not graphically represented.
applicableAreas: Entire site with transmission lines and distribution utilities

comment: No horizontal dashed height limit lines are shown on the site plan or erosion control plan to delineate the overhead transmission conductor clearance envelope boundaries. Transmission structures and easement are referenced in Sheet 3 General Notes but are not graphically depicted with height limit annotations on site plan sheets.

Two critical recorded easements (Greenbelt Access & Use Easement Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres; City of Austin Drainage Easement Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres) and four additional GIS-confirmed easements (10' Wastewater, 25' Drainage, 7.5' Public Utility, 10' Drainage) are not depicted on submitted site plan, preventing verification that utility easement boundaries do not encroach into proposed public right-of-way. Applicant must add all recorded easement boundaries to site plan before compliance can be verified.
applicableAreas: Entire site, particularly NE portion where drainage and greenbelt easements are located

comment: Submitted site plan does not show a dedicated AE easement encumbering transformer pad locations, nor is there notation of a License Agreement from AE Public Involvement per UCM § 1.10.10.3 or a City Manager license per § 14-11-41 for items within recorded utility easements. Utility easement status and licensing compliance cannot be verified from submitted documents. Provide AE easement plat or evidence of required license agreements.

Transformer Pad 3 is positioned less than 5 feet (nearly flush) against the exterior wall of Unit 801, violating the minimum 10-foot clearance requirement from any adjacent building or structure per UCM § 1.10.4(hot-stick/padlocked side). Transformer Pad 2, located in the tight corridor between Units 404 and 504, also appears to be positioned less than 10 feet from building exteriors. Additionally, no dedicated AE easement is shown on the site plan to encumber the transformer pad areas as required. Relocate transformer pads to satisfy minimum 10-foot clearance from all adjacent structures, and provide a dedicated AE easement plat encumbering the pad locations.
applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 3 (west of Unit 801); Transformer Pad 2 (between Units 404 and 504)

comment: No Electric Service Planning Application (ESPA) approval letter or submission documentation is visible in the site plan package. Austin Energy completeness check being marked complete does not constitute ESPA approval documentation.

Austin Energy Utility (AEU) clearance letter is not documented in the site plan package. While Austin Energy completeness check is noted as complete, no separate AEU clearance letter is visible to confirm approval.

Comprehensive Additional Review Acknowledgement table is not completed on the cover sheet listing all applicable external reviews and approvals (TxDOT permit, railroad permit, gas company permit, easement acquisition, county approval, water district approval, TCEQ approval, service extension approval, etc.) per UCM 2.5.1.F. A partial Additional Review Acknowledgement form addressing only water/wastewater and AULCC requirements is located on Sheet 18, but does not satisfy the requirement for a complete table on the cover sheet.

While Sheet 29 displays the addressing plan with individual unit numbers (Units 101-806), no documentation of approved addressing plan from 911 Addressing/Address Management Services is visible in the site plan package. An Address Validation Letter, if issued, does not constitute an approved addressing plan per UCM requirements.
